verdict.rationale: No evidence of a public Lovable platform API for programmatically creating/managing projects; the probe explicitly found no OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s), and all documented capabilities (Build mode, Git sync, Cloud backend) are chat/UI-driven rather than API-driven. The MCP-server feature only turns a *published app* into an MCP tool for assistants, not a platform-level API for managing Lovable apps themselves.
